Fisher_chart_energy.cross_inner_product_formula: C_ij_r=sum_c sqrt(q_i_r_c q_j_r_c) times a_i_r^T M_c a_j_r
Fisher_chart_energy.self_energy_formula: E_i_r=sum_c q_i_r_c times a_i_r^T M_c a_i_r
Fisher_chart_energy.weighted_activation_energy_formula: sum_c q_i_r_c times comparison_value_i_r^T M_c comparison_value_i_r
Fisher_chart_energy.weighted_chart_orthogonal_energy_formula: sum_c q_i_r_c alpha_c times squared_norm((I minus B_c B_c_transpose) a_i_r)
Fisher_chart_energy.weighted_chart_tangent_energy_formula: sum_c q_i_r_c times squared_norm(diag(inverse_scale_c) B_c_transpose a_i_r)

local_SPD_metric.formula: B_c diag(inverse_scale_c_squared) B_c_transpose plus alpha_c times (I minus B_c B_c_transpose)
